synthetic_routing.interpretation: Known FK endpoint, synthetic q1/q2 constraints only; not physical collision validation.

timing: CPU wall time, NumPy NN load excluded. Offline roadmap construction excluded from query timings; grow time recorded separately. Cache loading is not benchmarked. OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1.
interpretation: Real cases: limit-only space is convex, so graph detours add no feasibility. Roadmap seeds may improve endpoint IK. Numerical and NN multiseed variants share current/random/roadmap fallback seeds; NN adds four learned seeds (extra budget). Direct/PRM pairs have identical goal generation; compare them to isolate graph routing. Use attempts, success and timing to judge NN value, not only success on this small development set.
